verdict.rationale: Grok is a natural-language assistant at its core. The docs show users driving real actions from chat: creating Salesforce records, sending and replying in Teams, managing Google Drive files, and reaching email and calendar. Users can also talk to it hands-free by voice and hand work to Grok Bot agents, and one hands-on report praises how much it can intuit without micromanagement. Missing for 10: consistent independent corroboration of reliable agentic tool calling (one user reported tool-calling trouble with Grok 4), and evidence that account, settings and billing management can be done by natural-language command rather than the website UI.
